name: Paciente no identificado
criteria: select p.patient_id from patient p join person_attribute pa on pa.person_id = p.patient_id and pa.voided = 0 join person_attribute_type pat on pat.person_attribute_type_id = pa.person_attribute_type_id where p.voided = 0 and pat.uuid = '8b56eac7-5c76-4b9c-8c6f-1deab8d3fc47' and lower(pa.value) = 'true'
description: Visible cuando el registro fue creado como paciente no identificado o con identidad no verificada

name: Datos de identidad pendientes
criteria: select p.patient_id from patient p join person_attribute pa on pa.person_id = p.patient_id and pa.voided = 0 join person_attribute_type pat on pat.person_attribute_type_id = pa.person_attribute_type_id where p.voided = 0 and pat.uuid = '787f1ea9-1792-45e5-9076-699b1a0638cb' and pa.value in ('pending', 'partial')
description: Visible cuando la identificación del paciente sigue pendiente o parcial

name: Paciente incapaz de comunicarse
criteria: select p.patient_id from patient p join person_attribute pa on pa.person_id = p.patient_id and pa.voided = 0 join person_attribute_type pat on pat.person_attribute_type_id = pa.person_attribute_type_id where p.voided = 0 and pat.uuid = 'ee0fb3c8-0432-4035-97c1-e2315d347310' and pa.value in ('unconscious', 'comatose', 'disoriented', 'non_verbal')
description: Visible cuando el paciente no puede brindar datos o consentimiento por condición de comunicación

name: Requiere responsable
criteria: select p.patient_id from patient p where p.voided = 0 and (exists (select 1 from person_attribute pa join person_attribute_type pat on pat.person_attribute_type_id = pa.person_attribute_type_id where pa.person_id = p.patient_id and pa.voided = 0 and pat.uuid = '8b56eac7-5c76-4b9c-8c6f-1deab8d3fc47' and lower(pa.value) = 'true') or exists (select 1 from person_attribute pa join person_attribute_type pat on pat.person_attribute_type_id = pa.person_attribute_type_id where pa.person_id = p.patient_id and pa.voided = 0 and pat.uuid = 'ee0fb3c8-0432-4035-97c1-e2315d347310' and pa.value in ('unconscious', 'comatose', 'disoriented', 'non_verbal'))) and not exists (select 1 from person_attribute pa join person_attribute_type pat on pat.person_attribute_type_id = pa.person_attribute_type_id where pa.person_id = p.patient_id and pa.voided = 0 and pat.uuid = '4697d0e6-5b24-416b-aee6-708cd9a3a1db' and trim(pa.value) <> '')
description: Visible para registros antiguos o incompletos que no tienen responsable administrativo registrado
